mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a non-owner member to perform a successful PatchTask or DeleteTask, directly violating the owner-or-admin gate that FR-009 requires. The injection forces a concrete counterexample: a MemberRole operation on a task they do not own that succeeds.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerOrAdminViolation { some op : Operation | op.opKind = PatchTask and op.opCallerRole = MemberRole and op.opOutcome = Success and (all t : Task | t = op.opTask implies t.taskOwner != op.opCaller) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits a cross-team task access to succeed (outcome != NotFound404), which violates the byte-equivalent 404 isolation invariant from FR-014. The injection forces a cross-team operation to succeed, leaking the existence of a task in another team.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeakage { some op : Operation | op.opTask != none and op.opTask.taskTeam != op.opCallerTeam and op.opOutcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a task to exist with zero or two CreatedChange audit entries, breaking the per-edit-event completeness invariant from FR-015. The injection creates a task for which no CreatedChange entry exists.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingCreatedEntry { some t : Task | no ae : AuditEntry | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeChange = CreatedChange }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact disconnects the DeletedChange requirement from DeletedTask, allowing a deleted task to lack its final audit entry, which undermines the audit-outlives-task invariant from FR-016.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingDeletedEntry { some t : DeletedTask | no ae : AuditEntry | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeChange = DeletedChange }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a ModifiedChange audit entry to exist without a corresponding successful PatchTask operation, breaking attribution correctness (FR-015). The injection creates an unanchored ModifiedChange entry whose actor has no matching successful operation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnanchoredModifiedEntry { some ae : AuditEntry | ae.aeChange in ModifiedChange and (no op : Operation | op.opKind = PatchTask and op.opOutcome = Success and op.opTask = ae.aeTask and op.opCaller = ae.aeActor) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a MemberRole non-owner caller to receive an outcome other than Denied403 on PatchTask/DeleteTask for a task they don't own, which contradicts the 403 permission_denied requirement in FR-009 and the permission matrix. The injection forces a non-owner member to get Success.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerNotDenied { some op : Operation | op.opKind = PatchTask and op.opCallerRole = MemberRole and op.opTask != none and op.opTask.taskTeam = op.opCallerTeam and op.opTask.taskOwner != op.opCaller and op.opOutcome = Success }
